notes: Ahmedabad OPD mobile differs between the brief (+91-937-415-1616) and legacy site (+91-937-413-1616). The brief value is used here; verify before launch.
Map coordinates are approximate and should be verified before production release.
Business hours should be confirmed by the hospital team.
Gota, Himmatnagar and Juhapura contact numbers are temporary placeholders and must be replaced with real branch numbers before launch.
Every hospital page's lede, four facts and SEO text are drafted from the address and the network's own data, not confirmed by the hospital.

Only Visnagar's photographs are its own. Every other hospital page borrows them - the hero is deliberately the waiting hall rather than the Visnagar facade, so no page claims a building it cannot show. Replace per hospital as photography arrives.
No hospital names the services it actually offers yet, so every page lists all eleven. Add a `page.services` array of slugs to a branch to narrow it.
Bharuch and Gota addresses name no road, so their drawn maps carry an unlabelled road. Ask the hospital for the road name.
